The employer pays the total social insurance contribution and recovers the employee's share only by deduction from pay ([§ 28e SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28e.html), [§ 28g SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28g.html)).
germany-payroll.after: The employee owes the wage tax; the employer must withhold it at every wage payment ([§ 38 EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__38.html)) and is liable for it ([§ 42d(1) EStG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/estg/__42d.html)). The employer pays the total social insurance contribution and ordinarily recovers the employee's share by deduction from pay, subject to the § 28g exceptions stated below ([§ 28e SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28e.html), [§ 28g SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28g.html)).

germany-payroll.before: 8. **Contributions.** Cap pay at each branch's monthly ceiling, apply the shares, deduct the employee's. germany-payroll.after: 8. **Contributions.** Cap pay at each branch's monthly ceiling, apply the shares, deduct the employee's. Under § 28g SGB IV the ordinary claim is recovered by deduction from pay. A missed deduction can ordinarily be recovered at the next three payments, and later if the employer was not at fault. The deduction-only and three-payment restrictions do not apply where the employee intentionally or grossly negligently breaches § 28o(1), bears the entire total social contribution, or receives only benefits in kind. ([§ 28g SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28g.html)).

germany-payroll.after: What breaks when the order is wrong: without wage tax data the tax runs in class VI and is corrected later; a missed employee deduction cannot ordinarily be recovered after the next three payments unless the employer-nonfault or other § 28g exception above applies; a late contribution statement lets the fund estimate the pay ([§ 28f(3) SGB IV](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/sgb_4/__28f.html)).

germany-payroll.after: - **Several jobs.** Several Minijobs are added together. If aggregation shows that the minor-employment conditions fail, insurance begins on the day the competent insurance decision is notified under § 8(2) SGB IV, unless the employer intentionally or grossly negligently failed to investigate the facts needed to assess insurance status. germany-payroll.after: - **Continued pay in sickness.** For incapacity due to sickness without employee fault, up to six weeks per incapacity, at the pay for regular working time without overtime pay, once the job has lasted four weeks without a break. The same illness again gives a new six weeks only after six months without incapacity from it, or twelve months after the first incapacity from it began ([§ 3 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__3.html), [§ 4 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__4.html)). Small employers in U1 get part of it back (80% under the statute). Under § 4(1a) EntgFG, additional overtime pay is excluded, as are expense reimbursements contingent on actual expenses that do not arise during incapacity. For performance-related remuneration, use the average earnings achievable during the employee's applicable regular working time.

de-payroll.before: **Sick pay and the maternity top-up.** Continued pay for up to six weeks per incapacity, once the job has lasted four weeks without a break; the same illness again gives a new six weeks only after six months free of it, or twelve months after the first incapacity from it began ([§ 3 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__3.html)), at the pay for regular working time ([§ 4 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__4.html)). During the protection periods and the day of birth the employer pays the difference between EUR 13 and the average net pay per calendar day ([§ 20(1) MuSchG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/muschg_2018/__20.html)); U2 refunds it ([§ 1(2) AAG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/aufag/__1.html)).
de-payroll.after: **Sick pay and the maternity top-up.** Continued pay for up to six weeks per incapacity due to sickness without employee fault, once the job has lasted four weeks without a break; the same illness again gives a new six weeks only after six months free of it, or twelve months after the first incapacity from it began ([§ 3 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__3.html)), at the pay for regular working time ([§ 4 EntgFG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/entgfg/__4.html)). During the protection periods and the day of birth the employer pays the difference between EUR 13 and the average net pay per calendar day ([§ 20(1) MuSchG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/muschg_2018/__20.html)); U2 refunds it ([§ 1(2) AAG](https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/aufag/__1.html)). Under § 4(1a) EntgFG, additional overtime pay is excluded, as are expense reimbursements contingent on actual expenses that do not arise during incapacity. For performance-related remuneration, use the average earnings achievable during the employee's applicable regular working time.
